problems_checked.P1: Confirmed Minor. Direct warped-product curvature gives both sectional curvatures -1, Ric=-n g for complete hyperbolic H^(n+1); SO(n+1) is compact and acts with cohomogeneity one, satisfying the preliminary statement's actual hypotheses without compactness. The witness is not on S10. In the actual closed sphere setting a nonzero Killing field plus the integrated Bochner identity excludes negative Einstein constant; at zero it would be a nonzero parallel field, impossible on S10 (Euler characteristic2). Thus the demonstrated defect is preliminary scope, not the main existence conclusion.
problems_checked.P2: Confirmed Minor after correcting the initial report's own hypothesis check. Definition3.3 on actual p16 means an eventual inequality, not equality to a limiting angle. For gamma1=beta and gamma2=alpha, truncated angles are 1-u and u-1. Eventually >=1/2 and <=-1/2, so theta0=1 is admissible; theta0=2 was not justified. The same simple disjoint curves enter, exit and re-enter every sufficiently small disk by the three radii 1/(x-pi),3/x,1/(x+pi), with all hypotheses met. A first-arrival time exists and tends to the omitted endpoint by compact-prefix positive distance. The retained prefixes lie outside the circle, preserve the eventual angle bounds, and can be connected with a positive arc creating no additional intersections. Actual pp22-24 use two strict bounds >2pi, hence reflected difference >4pi, winding>=3 and >=2 intersections; the replacement preserves exactly that needed count. Neither Lemma3.4's conclusion nor TheoremA is disproved.
